parameters.name: ActionName
parameters.description: The name of the playbook action.

parameters.name: AssetId
parameters.description: The ID of the resource. This parameter is deprecated and no longer used.

parameters.name: ComponentName
parameters.description: The name of the playbook component.

parameters.name: Content
parameters.description: The content of the message sent by the webhook of the DingTalk group robot.

parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description:
The language of the request and response. Valid values:

- **zh** (default): Chinese.

- **en**: English.

parameters.name: MsgType
parameters.description:
The message type of the webhook. Valid values:

- text

- markdown

- actionCard

parameters.name: NodeName
parameters.description: The name of the playbook node.

parameters.name: PlaybookUuid
parameters.description:
The UUID of the playbook.

> Call the [DescribePlaybooks](~~3000306~~) operation to obtain this parameter.

parameters.name: RoleFor
parameters.description: The UID of the member that the administrator wants to switch to.

parameters.name: RoleType
parameters.description:
The view type. Valid values:

- 0 (default): the view of the current Alibaba Cloud account.

- 1: the view of all accounts that belong to the enterprise.

parameters.name: Secret
parameters.description: The secret key for the webhook of the DingTalk group robot. This parameter is deprecated and no longer used.

parameters.name: Webhook
parameters.description: The IDs of the DingTalk robots. Obtain the IDs on the robot management page in Message Center.
